subject: Quarter Launchboard: Objectives, KPIs, and Sign-off
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter Launchboard: Objectives, KPIs, and Sign-off

Team / Jordan —

Attached is the draft Launchboard for the upcoming quarter (spreadsheet + linked README in Drive). This is the canonical set of objectives and proposed KPIs we plan to use for the Q3 kickoff and QBR packet. High level asks:

- Internal: please review the Objectives sheet and leave inline comments / suggested metric edits by EOD Fri (2027-05-21). Focus on measurable KPIs and any resource blockers.
- External (Jordan / Acme): confirming these success criteria aligns with your SOW expectations — do any of the metrics need tailoring for your integration?
- Proposed sign-off slots: I added three 30-minute options on my Calendly (link below). If we can lock a time early next week we’ll finalize the doc and hand to comms for the QBR packet.

Notes: the current draft intentionally keeps objectives compact (3 company-level objectives + 6 supporting team goals). If we need to reduce scope or break into phases, flag the items you think are non-essential for an initial canary.

Attachments: 2027-Q3-objectives-draft.xlsx (includes target baselines), Launchboard-README (Drive link).

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Launchboard: Objectives, KPIs, and Sign-off

Thanks Diego — quick pass from me. A few inline notes in the spreadsheet, plus summary here:

- Objective 1 (Reduce inference cost): keep, but change KPI from "cost per token" to "median cost per 1k requests at 95th percentile" — gives a clearer production view.
- Objective 2 (Latency & Reliability): add p99 latency for 4k token window (we've seen tail spikes that matter for product SLAs).
- Objective 3 (Model coverage & quality): suggest a "regression rate" KPI (percentage of eval prompts failing threshold) so we can gate rollouts.

On rollout: recommend canary at 5% of traffic for two weeks before ramp. If Acme needs a longer canary, flag here.

I'll mark comments in the sheet. Happy to join the sign-off call.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Launchboard: Objectives, KPIs, and Sign-off

Thanks — high level reactions:

- We need to be realistic on resourcing. Several team goals assume +30% infra ops FTE or additional GPU capacity that isn't budgeted yet. See attached capacity-model.pdf.
- Suggest we reduce the number of measurable team goals from 6 -> 4 for the first release so we can guarantee delivery.
- For Objective 1 KPI: curious if we can measure cost as both total spend and normalized per-embedding call. We should avoid conflicting metrics in the QBR deck.

I'll add comments to the doc, but we should schedule a 20-minute alignment with Eng leads before sign-off to confirm capacity and rollout schedule.

-Markus

From: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Launchboard: Objectives, KPIs, and Sign-off

Diego / Team — thanks for sharing. A few quick items from Acme's side:

- The objective KPIs look aligned with our internal success metrics, but we need to confirm the SLA targets (p99 latency, availability %) that will back the SOW. Can you confirm the p99 target for the primary model?
- Data residency: our legal team needs confirmation that customer data stays in us-west for Q3. Is Redwood's deployment plan compatible?
- Compliance: will you provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and recent penetration test report for vendor assessment? Procurement needs those docs to move to contract signature.

Appreciate a response today if possible so procurement can keep the timeline.

Best,
Jordan Li
Senior Technical Program Manager, Acme Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Launchboard: Objectives, KPIs, and Sign-off

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers below; attaching SOC2 readiness deck and linking to the compliance page.

- SLA / p99 target: we propose p99 <= 450ms for the primary model at canary traffic levels; for full production throughput target is p99 <= 650ms. We will include both numbers in the QBR appendix so expectations are explicit.
- Data residency: yes — for Acme we will pin instances to us-west region (VPC-private) for the quarter and provide confirmation in the deployment runbook.
- Compliance: attaching the SOC2 readiness deck (summary + timeline). We will provide the Type II attestation before production ramp; the pentest report is available under NDA — I can loop Security (cc'ed) if you want a direct handoff.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal: Markus / Eng leads to confirm capacity changes by EOD Fri.
2) External: Jordan/procurement — confirm if you need the pentest under NDA.
3) Sign-off call — please pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/diego-redwood/launchboard-signoff-30

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 12:30 PM Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmehealth.com> wrote:

> - Data residency: our legal team needs confirmation that customer data stays in us-west for Q3. Is Redwood's deployment plan compatible?
> - Compliance: will you provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and recent penetration test report for vendor assessment? Procurement needs those docs to move to contract signature.

Thanks — Diego

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Launchboard: Objectives, KPIs, and Sign-off

All — quick note to confirm executive alignment.

- The objective set and the KPI adjustments Laura proposed are approved. I support the tighter p99 language in the appendix and the regression-rate metric for model rollouts.
- Markus: prioritize capacity confirmation; if additional budget is required, loop Finance and we’ll prioritize the runway for this customer-critical initiative.
- Jordan: welcome — we'll provide SOC2 Type II and arrange the pentest NDA handoff. Diego, please coordinate Security to send the artifact.

Consider this a sign-off from leadership for the current Launchboard version contingent on Markus' capacity confirmation.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
COO, Redwood Inference
